notes.title: Update 1.3
notes.content:
This release contains 2 fixes:

- Firing weapons can break the game some times. This has been fixed.
- In the world view hovering the mouse over a disappearing hex can break the game. This has been fixed.

notes.title: Update 1.2
notes.content:
This release fixes problems that have been making the mid and late game a bad experience. This release contains the following changes:

[list]
[*] Fix ram into unit defect
[*] Nerf Panther cannon
[*] Fix unit location defect
[*] Fix 0 hit points unit not destroyed defect
[*] Fix hex is unaccessible defect
[*] Fix turret rotation defect
[*] Fix collision defect
[*] Fix escaping unit defect
[*] Fix part replacement defect
[*] Make war band creator more big vehicle biased
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.1.2
notes.content: Fixed looting defects where items disappear.

notes.title: Update Notes release April 2th 2023
notes.content: Added error logging from the game to a server to help with finding players' game problems.

notes.title: Update Notice March 14th
notes.content:
The following features and fixes have been added to Cursed Road Convoy:

[list]
[*] Enable submit with spacebar on the various menus.
[*] Make the cursor center on the active vehicle on the combat view for keyboard controls.
[*] Info popups on hover over on units and settlements on the world view.
[*] Access to the loot view on the world view by clicking on the player's emblem.
[*] Add a steam achievement for killing all Death Metals vehicles types.
[/list]
